file_spec.value: "Passport photograph in JPG or PNG format." — stated on the official Sierra Leone Immigration Department Online Passport Applications portal as one of the uploaded/required items. No further compression, resolution, or file-size limit is stated.

official_source_url.value: https://slid.gov.sl/ (Sierra Leone Immigration Department) — application is processed via the online portal https://passport.slid.datahub.gov.sl. Neither the department's main site, its Fees page, nor the online portal publish a photo size, background colour, or head-height specification.
